result.reason: The operative language eliminates the USD 25,000-per-day liquidated damages obligation, achieving the preferred position. It preserves the clause’s delay-allocation purpose through schedule relief and a limited actual-cost remedy. However, allowing recovery of documented idle-resource costs creates a new monetary remedy not necessary to implement the no-liquidated-damages position; day-for-day schedule relief alone would have been a more minimal revision. The drafting is generally clear and professional, though the scope of recoverable idle-resource costs could be defined more precisely.
